response.justification: Candidate is a strong, versatile software engineer with deep experience in web/mobile/backend systems (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, JavaScript), but lacks the core requirements for this role: minimal C++ experience (a brief stint in 2014-2015 and a bachelor thesis project), no evidence of Windows-platform C++ development at the required depth, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and systems-level software engineering experience across many languages and platforms
Strong track record of leadership, mentoring, and technical communication (talks, workshops, open source)
Demonstrated CI/CD, Docker, and DevOps infrastructure experience
concerns: Only a few months of C/C++ experience roughly a decade ago, far short of the 5-10 years required
No visible experience with SQL Server or Oracle specifically, or with Windows-platform development
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience anywhere in work history

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income/investment banking domain exposure
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
